metadata.description: Skills for working with RudderStack via CLI, MCP server, Terraform, and Profiles workflows.

plugins.name: rudder-core
plugins.description: Cross-tool RudderStack domain knowledge: data catalog, tracking plans, data graphs, instrumentation planning, instrumentation debugging, and destination delivery debugging.

plugins.name: rudder-cli
plugins.description: Workflows for driving rudder-cli: validate, dry-run, apply, import, transformations, and typed client generation with rudder-cli typer.

plugins.name: rudder-mcp
plugins.description: Workflows for RudderStack's MCP server at mcp.rudderstack.com: connect AI/LLM agents to a RudderStack workspace and drive it via MCP tool calls.

plugins.name: rudder-terraform
plugins.description: Workflows for managing RudderStack with the Terraform provider: provider setup, resource/data-source usage, and plan/apply cycles.

plugins.name: rudder-profiles
plugins.description: Workflows for building RudderStack Profiles projects: setup, project creation, project analysis, controlled updates, and debugging.
